newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sale of Portugal's Tabaqueira may be delayed-paper.
newsitem.headline: Sale of Portugal's Tabaqueira may be delayed-paper.

text.p: The privatisation of Portuguese tobacco company Tabaqueira may be delayed 45 days after Economy Minister Augusto Mateus consulted the Competition Council about the likely impact of the sale, a Lisbon newspaper reported.

Diario Economico quoted an Economy Ministry source as saying the Council, formally contacted by Mateus on Tuesday, had 30 days to issue an opinion and the minister had set himself 15 additional days before taking any decision on the sale.
Economy Ministry officials were not immediately available to comment on the report.

The candidates to buy Tabaqueira are the U.S. group Philip Morris, in partnership with Portugal's Jorge de Mello group; state-owned Spanish tobacco company Tabacalera, allied to Madeira company Empresa Madeirense de Tabacos ; and French group Seita.
